Container.Name: calendar
Container.Overview: Self-hosted calendar. Add events by text message through voip.ms ("Dentist tue 3pm"), view them in a phone-friendly web page, and subscribe from your phone's calendar app.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the calendar database is stored

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the web page asks for this password (any username).

Config.Name: Feed token
Config.Description: Long random string. Enables the phone subscription feed at /calendar.ics?token=...

Config.Name: voip.ms API password
Config.Description: The API password set under Main Menu, SOAP and REST/JSON API (not your login password)

Config.Name: voip.ms number (DID)
Config.Description: The voip.ms number that receives your texts, digits only

Config.Name: Allowed numbers
Config.Description: Phone numbers allowed to add events, comma separated

Config.Name: Poll interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to check voip.ms for new texts
